test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

EAGER
solution: The correct answer is '**Indifferent**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Eager**' is **Indifferent**'. • **Eager**: keenly expectant or interested. (बेहद उम्मीद या दिलचस्पी) • *Example: Small **eager** faces looked up and listened.* • **Indifferent**: not interested in or care about somebody/something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु में रुचि या सोच-विचार से रहित; उदासीन) • *Example: The manager of the shop seemed **indifferent** to our complaints.* **Correct Answer:__** *Indifferent.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Easier**: not difficult. (आसान, सरल) • **Different**: not the same. (भिन्‍न, अलग प्रकार का, एक जैसा नहीं) • **Loveable**: having a personality or appearance that is easy to love. (प्‍यारा लगने वाला, आकर्षक) 33:Tbe9, The correct answer is **'to get'.**
